description: This file defines an authentication API router for a FastAPI application. It handles user registration, login, profile retrieval, and logout functionalities using JWT tokens. The code includes route handlers, database interactions, password hashing, and token creation.

classes.name: User
classes.description: ORM model representing a user in the database.

classes.name: UserSchema
classes.description: Pydantic model for user schema, used for serialization/deserialization.

methods.name: register_user(user: UserCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Handles user registration, creates a new user with hashed password, and returns a JWT token.

methods.name: login_user(user_credentials: UserLogin, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Authenticates user credentials and returns a JWT token on success.

methods.name: get_current_user_info(current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Returns information about the currently authenticated user.

methods.name: logout_user(current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Logs out the current user, instructing client to discard the token.

ctags.name: UserSchema
ctags.pattern: /^from app.schemas import UserCreate, UserLogin, Token, User as UserSchema$/

ctags.name: login_user
ctags.pattern: /^async def login_user(user_credentials: UserLogin, db: Session = Depends(get_db)):$/

ctags.name: register_user
ctags.pattern: /^async def register_user(user: UserCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db)):$/
